hub.intro: If one day there is no internet or signal, keep what really matters at hand: how to find each other, who to call and what to keep at home.
hub.planEmpty: Meeting points, contacts, important numbers and health
hub.planEmptyNoHealth: Meeting points, contacts and important numbers
hub.kitEmpty: Work out water and food for your household and tick what you have
hub.exportBody: On paper it works even when the phone's battery is dead.
hub.guidesBody: Download them now: without internet you won't be able to.
hub.privacy: Everything you write here is stored only on this device.
hub.resetBody: Your contacts, meeting points, notes, kit and its reminders will be deleted. This can't be undone.

plan.title: Family plan
plan.intro: Agree on it together and give everyone a paper copy.
plan.numbersFooter: Bank, cards, insurance, building manager… Never store passwords or PINs.
plan.peopleFooter: Medication, allergies and blood type of everyone at home.
plan.homeNotesEmpty: How to open the garage or the lock by hand, water and gas shut-off valves, building rules…

meeting.primaryHint: Near home, if you can't go back or reach each other
meeting.secondaryHint: Outside the neighborhood, in case the main one can't be reached
meeting.detailsPlaceholder: E.g. If we can't reach each other, meet there at 6 pm. Wait 1 hour.
meeting.noMarkers: To place it on the map, long-press the map in Maps to drop a pin, then choose it here.

person.name: Name
person.medicationsPlaceholder: E.g. Ventolin, 2 puffs in an attack

kit.title: Emergency kit
kit.intro: The basics to get through at least 72 hours without power, running water or shops.
kit.sources: Rough amounts: 4 L (about 1 gallon) of water per person per day, as Ready.gov and Spain's Civil Protection advise.

waterPurification.title: Purification tablets or a filter
waterPurification.hint: In case the bottled water runs out

food.title: Food that needs no cooking
food.hint: Canned food, canned beans, nuts, crackers

stove.title: Camping stove and fuel
stove.hint: Outdoors or with good ventilation only

batteries.title: Spare batteries
batteries.hint: In the sizes your flashlight and radio take

whistle.title: Whistle
whistle.hint: To call for help without losing your voice

printedPlan.title: This plan, printed
printedPlan.hint: Export it as a PDF from Preparedness

painRelief.title: Pain relievers and fever reducers
painRelief.hint: In children's doses too if there are kids

cash.title: Cash
cash.hint: In small notes: card terminals won't work

documentCopies.title: Copies of documents
documentCopies.hint: ID, passport, insurance and prescriptions, in a waterproof bag

spareKeys.title: Spare keys
spareKeys.hint: For the house and the car

kidsFood.title: Food the kids will actually eat

kidsEntertainment.title: Games, books and pencils
kidsEntertainment.hint: Download stories in the Library too

babySupplies.title: Diapers and wipes
babySupplies.hint: If there are babies at home

petSupplies.title: Pet food and water
petSupplies.hint: Plus a lead, carrier and their medication
